newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden reaches visa-free agreement with Latvia.
newsitem.headline: Sweden reaches visa-free agreement with Latvia.

text.p: Sweden and Latvia reached an agreement on visa-free travel between them on Monday but Sweden said the deal would not become valid until Latvia signed the Geneva convention on refugees without regional reservations.

"Many countries have made certain amendments to, or interpretations of, the Geneva convention but we think Latvia has made too many reservations," a spokeswoman at the Swedish foreign ministry told Reuters.
"In particular, Latvia only acknowledges refugees from a limited number of countries."
Sweden objects to those regional reservations and expects Latvia to change them, she said.
The deal follows negotiations in Riga on March 24-25, the Swedish foreign ministry said in a statement.
Earlier this year Sweden lifted visa requirements for the two other Baltic countries, Estonia and Lithuania.
